title: A reading room that flows.
summary: A quieter navigation menu, device-aware appearance and installation together in settings. Discover the highest-rated classics or shuffle for something new, with fluid curved page turns and a new reading activity calendar.

title: More stories. Wherever you read.
summary: A thousand complete classics and a fresh daily selection. A deeper Dual reading view and clearer installation bring your reading room along. Compact sounds stream on demand, with optional downloads for offline listening.

title: Settle into your next chapter.
summary: New focus sounds and flexible book brightness. Simpler page marking and a coordinated reading room. Colourful reading milestones to celebrate your progress.

title: A reading room worth discovering.
summary: Dedicated pages for every classic, stronger search and sharing previews, and a coordinated mobile library with clear book-import feedback.

title: More worlds to get lost in.
summary: 750 complete classics, with 250 new books across the collection. More fairy tales, nature writing, novellas, poetry and lesser-explored genres. Coordinated library buttons and individually coloured feature cards.

title: Your book. Your colours.
summary: Ten hardcover colours, precise zoom controls and an organised home for the reader’s contents, marks and settings.

title: A new chapter with Casid Studio.
summary: An understated hardcover with page depth that changes as you read. Weekly backup reminders, EPUB typography controls and in-app word lookup. Updated document engines and stronger browser protections.

title: Make the room your own.
summary: Unified marking tools and clearer bookmark controls. 7- and 30-day statistics with chart choices and a daily breakdown. Refreshed identity, mobile layouts and read-aloud flow.

title: Your library, ready to travel.
summary: Full ZIP backup and restore for books, notes, progress and settings. Direct device transfer through QR pairing. Export annotations as Markdown or plain text.

title: Five hundred ways to begin.
summary: A public collection of 500 complete classics across a wider range of genres. Refined library browsing, book information and consistent card layouts.

title: More stories. More choice.
summary: The public library grows to 300 complete books, searchable by title, author and genre.

title: Your private reading room.
summary: Book-style PDF reading, a personal shelf and progress saved on your device. A public library of 100 classics, alongside notes, highlights and reading tools. Offline reading and automatic online app updates.
